newsitem.title: MONACO: SOCCER-MONACO'S PETIT AND GRIMANDI TO JOIN ARSENAL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MONACO'S PETIT AND GRIMANDI TO JOIN ARSENAL.

text.p: French international defender Emmanuel Petit and midfielder Gilles Grimandi are leaving Monaco to join Arsenal, the French soccer champions said on Wednesday.
The club did not disclose details of transfer fees.
Petit and Grimandi, both 26, will link up again with the English premier league club's coach Arsene Wenger, their Monaco boss when they began their professional careers.
Petit, linked with Spain's Valencia, Glasgow Rangers and Internazionale, has been capped 17 times.
